train_rule: all eligible rows strictly earlier in sorted eligible table except frozen last300; same feature rules
holdout_rule: latest 300 chronologically among rows with >=8 complete books at grid 48,60,66,71 and >=8 common books at 48/71

baseline.name: grid71_32book_consensus_no_vig
baseline.definition: For each bookmaker with complete H/D/A odds at grid71, convert odds to normalized implied H/D/A probabilities; take median across books; renormalize three medians to sum1.

challenger.standardization: training mean and population sd only; sd floor 1e-12
challenger.fit: L2 penalized logistic by IRLS/Newton; intercept unpenalized; lambda=1.0; max_iter=50; tol=1e-8
challenger.h_a_allocation: after qD, preserve baseline H:A ratio: qH=(1-qD)*pH/(pH+pA), qA=(1-qD)*pA/(pH+pA)

primary_gate.probability_layer_pass: HDA_logloss_delta<0 AND Draw_logloss_delta<0 AND Draw_Brier_delta<0 AND Draw_AUC_delta>0
primary_gate.note: both reported separately; no promotion from one alone

independence_caveat: Repository-wide historical consumption overlap cannot be proven from currently recoverable manifests; therefore this fixed300 is NOT labeled independent OOS unless exact overlap audit later proves zero overlap.
